translations.web: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek Yahweh; but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself from them.
translations.bsb: They go with their flocks and herds to seek the LORD, but they do not find Him; He has withdrawn Himself from them.
translations.kjv: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn
translations.asv: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek Jehovah; but they shall not find him: he hath withdrawn himself from them.
